描述_EN: Butterflies change from caterpillars and larvae through chrysalis to adults. The ancient Japanese were mystified by this change and apparently saw the spirits of the dead in the butterflies that emerged from their suspended state and flew away. In literature, they were also seen as fallible and unreliable. However, when the positive image of the butterfly was imported from China, its beautiful, petite appearance was used as a decorative element in the culture of the Heian Dynasty (794-1185). Thereafter, it was established as a motif depicted alongside autumn grasses and folding flowers. A washbasin is a device used to collect hot water for washing, bathing or giving birth. They were also part of the wedding furniture and were beautifully decorated.
描述_ZN: 蝴蝶从毛毛虫和幼虫经过蛹变成了成虫。 古代日本人对这种变化感到神秘，显然在那些从悬浮状态中出现并飞走的蝴蝶身上看到了死者的灵魂。 在文学作品中，它们也被视为易变和不可靠的东西。 然而，当蝴蝶的正面形象从中国传入后，它美丽、娇小的外表在平安王朝（794-1185）的文化中被用作装饰元素。 此后，它被确立为一种与秋草和折枝花一起描绘的图案。 洗脸盆是一种用来收集洗脸、洗澡或分娩用的热水的装置。 它们也是婚礼家具的一部分，并被装饰得非常漂亮。
